note: Ultimenu derives a mega-menu block from a menu and turns each enabled top-level menu item into a dynamic region. Its persistent state is (a) the ultimenu.settings config object (keys blocks, regions, goodies, skins, fallback_text, ajaxmw, icon_class, offcanvases) and (b) block config entities using the derivative plugin ultimenu_block:ultimenu-<menu>. A menu only becomes a placeable block after it is listed non-empty in ultimenu.settings:blocks (checkbox stores <menu>: <menu>). There is no config/install default, so ultimenu.settings does not exist until first saved. Configure route ultimenu.settings (/admin/structure/ultimenu), permission 'administer ultimenu'. Depends on Blazy 3.x and core block+menu. Medium reads back which menu is configured as an Ultimenu block; hard cases enable a menu as an Ultimenu block and place a real Ultimenu block instance, both verified against live config/state.

evals.prompt: Explain the core idea of the Drupal Ultimenu module: what becomes a block and what becomes a region, and where do those regions come from?
evals.expected_output: An Ultimenu block is derived from a menu; each enabled top-level menu item of that menu becomes a dynamic region you can place ordinary blocks into (a block that contains regions containing blocks). The regions are contributed at runtime via hook_system_info_alter(), so you do not edit the theme .info.yml.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site with Ultimenu enabled, what is the admin path and configuration route of the Ultimenu settings form, and which permission gates it?
evals.expected_output: The settings form is at /admin/structure/ultimenu, route ultimenu.settings, gated by the 'administer ultimenu' permission. It edits the ultimenu.settings config object (keys: blocks, regions, goodies, skins, fallback_text, ajaxmw, icon_class, offcanvases).

evals.prompt: In Ultimenu, what is the machine id of the block plugin it provides, and how is a per-menu block instance identified? Give the derivative id form for the Main navigation menu.
evals.expected_output: The block plugin id is ultimenu_block; a deriver yields one derivative per menu enabled under ultimenu.settings:blocks, with id ultimenu_block:ultimenu-<menu> — for Main navigation that is ultimenu_block:ultimenu-main.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has Ultimenu installed and one menu has been enabled as an Ultimenu mega-menu block. Inspect the live ultimenu.settings configuration and name which menu (machine name) is configured as an Ultimenu block.
evals.expected_output: The 'footer' menu is enabled: ultimenu.settings has blocks.footer = 'footer', so the derivative block ultimenu_block:ultimenu-footer is available.

evals.prompt: This Ultimenu site has an AJAX mobile max-width configured (below which flyout panels auto-load instead of opening on click). Inspect the live ultimenu.settings configuration and give the configured value.
evals.expected_output: ultimenu.settings has ajaxmw = '481px' (the AJAX mobile max-width).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site with Ultimenu installed, enable the 'content' menu as an Ultimenu mega-menu block so that its derivative block becomes placeable. Apply the change to the live site's ultimenu.settings configuration.
evals.expected_output: Set ultimenu.settings blocks.content = 'content' (e.g. tick 'content' under Ultimenu blocks and Save, or edit config in code) and clear block plugin definitions. Verify checks blocks.content is non-empty and the plugin ultimenu_block:ultimenu-content exists.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the 'main' menu is already enabled as an Ultimenu block. Place an instance of the Main navigation Ultimenu block into a normal region of the default theme (olivero) and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a block config entity with plugin ultimenu_block:ultimenu-main placed in an ordinary (non-Ultimenu) region such as header. Verify passes when such a block instance exists and its region does not start with 'ultimenu'.
